basic_info.description: This fully detached four flat Victorian era building has been in the same family for generations.  With four separate entrances, an abundance of aesthetic appeal, and one or two of the apartments being delivered vacant at closing, this extraordinary investment opportunity is well suited for one or more owner occupant(s), yet equally well suited for savvy investors that will find value wherever they look. The premier location combines the charm of a historic, tree lined street, with the convenience of city living at its best. Shopping, dining, and public transportation are at your doorstep; making the four flats at 260 Clinton Park one of the very best income property investments available in San Francisco.
